_comment: Eight short conversational turns with deterministic, checkable answers. Assertions are whole-word regex matches against the LLM's text only - never against transcribed audio. Each entry lists every phrasing we accept, including spelled-out numbers, because the system prompt constrains length but not numeral style.

prompts.prompt: How many centimeters are in two meters?
How many minutes are in three hours?
If today is Monday, what day is it in three days?
What's fifteen percent of two hundred?
How many days are in February in a leap year?
